slots.title: Nikkei down 2.6% after BOJ holds rates
slots.body:

The Bank of Japan kept policy unchanged and described room for future rate increases after inflation reached a long-sought milestone, per WSJ coverage ahead of the decision.

Hang Seng finished +1.7% at 23,338.00 in the same overnight window for Asia.

slots.title: US session recap — Oct. 30, 2026
slots.body:
The Nasdaq Composite closed −1.4% at 26,184.72, off 365.13 points, while the S&P 500 was −0.3% at 7,720.39 and the Dow Jones Industrial Average −0.3% at 52,342.56.

The Russell 2000 went the other way, +1.0% to 2,859.22, so the headline index weakness did not match the small-cap benchmark for the session.

Alphabet led the megacap story: $GOOGL −12.6% to 283.82 and $GOOG −12.3% to 282.32, with coverage linking the drop to search revenue and pressure across large tech.

Amazon finished −4.2% at 243.79; chip-heavy names were softer but smaller in percentage terms—$AMD −2.1% to 566.42, $NVDA −0.8% to 213.66, and $INTC −3.6% to 92.07 among active semiconductor-related prints.

Meta bucked part of the tech weakness, closing +2.0% at 624.52; Taiwan Semi $TSM −1.8% to 431.81.

Payment networks closed higher:
- $MA +4.2% to 635.70
- $V +2.5% to 410.54

alongside a +0.6% average move in Nasdaq-listed financial services.

Consumer and defensive staples showed green ticks:
- $HD +3.6% to 328.98
- $WMT +2.1% to 121.25
- $PG +1.5% to 160.59
- $KO +1.2% to 92.82

Utilities led sector averages on the Nasdaq taxonomy at about +1.4%, with industrials about +1.2%; technology averaged about −0.5% and basic materials about −0.9%.

- $ADT +33.2% to 9.87
- $GKOS +33.6%
- $CROX +25.5%

were other large percentage movers in that screen.

Chicago PMI for October was on the US calendar for 1:45 p.m.
ET with a 56.1 consensus and 58.8 prior reading; the injected close bundle did not include a released actual for that print.

Several large caps on the Oct. 30 earnings calendar moved at the close without reported actuals in this dataset—among them:
- $GD +4.6% to 370.82
- $XOM +0.7% to 183.29
- $CVX +1.0% to 231.46
- $ABBV +1.7% to 290.97

Oil-linked quotes firmed: Brent +1.2% to 112.08 and the USO ETF +1.0% to 168.19, after headlines on supply concerns and attacks on Saudi Arabia; gold futures −0.8% to 4,000.90.

The VIX rose +1.7% to 17.20; Bitcoin USD was +0.4% at 78,088.88 despite earlier crypto headlines around a Binance security incident.

Overseas, the Nikkei 225 was −2.7% at 62,940.19; the Hang Seng +1.7% at 23,339.00; the FTSE 100 +0.3% at 10,722.07.

Treasury snapshot dated Oct. 28 in the feed showed the 10-year at 5.0% and the 2s10s spread at 0.38 percentage points.
